turns.replyText:
At Tediber, we want you to be sure of your choice. That is why we offer a 100-night trial period for our mattresses, bed bases, and sofas. For bed linen and mattress protectors, you have a 30-day trial period.

If the products do not suit you, returns are entirely free of charge.

To initiate a return, you simply need to contact our team by sending an email to hello@tediber.com or by filling out the return form on our website. We will then guide you through the next steps, such as scheduling a collection for large items or providing a prepaid label for smaller ones.

Once your product is received at our warehouse, your refund will be processed on the original payment method, generally within 72 hours to 15 business days depending on the item.

Feel free to contact us anytime; we're here to help.
